decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A639-PM02, A639-PM03, A639-PM01, A639-PM04, A639/L1, A639-PL04 Rev A, A639-PL03 Rev B, A639-PL02 Rev A, A639-PL01 Rev B, Heritage Statement and Design and Access Statement - Received 25/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, part single storey side extension with alteration to the roof of the existing side extension, enlargement of flank dormer, installation of two flank roof lights, modification to front gates to the house, repairs to existing fenestration and to the roof, and associated internal alterations.
